name: 4qg6r2-tracker-stop
goal: Prove a slow hub exits before activation or restoration and packaged startup records its result.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Desktop README and incidents 0j8kry/8b9716 specify delayed job removal before bootstrap and readable install outcomes.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing installer update and rollback cases previously accepted immediate bootout/bootstrap and did not inspect packaged outcome logs. They now simulate 5.25/6.5s and a stuck job.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Harness recorded committed red 34b6eee690. 5.25s update rolled back; the readiness rollback attempted 8 bootstraps instead of 2.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Installer commit adds a bounded launchd removal check for activation and rollback, propagates failed unload-only rollback and writes packaged-start results to the private Tracker logs directory.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Recorded red e94758266d (wrong rollback and 9 bootstrap attempts) and green 29ce732a08 through the same packaged entry and frozen tests. All seven passed, including rollback, log records and a stuck PID. Primary read-only launchctl lookup confirmed top-level PID format and absent service exit 113.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
